# orchestration_cluster_role_members (Data Source)

Lists the members of a role inside a Camunda cluster, grouped by member type, including members that Terraform does not manage. An empty member list is a valid result; a role that does not exist is an error. Clients exist only as members of groups, roles and tenants, so they are listed here and have no data source of their own. See the Camunda documentation on [roles](https://docs.camunda.io/docs/components/admin/role/).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Also works for built-in roles that Terraform does not manage.
data "orchestration_cluster_role_members" "example" {
  role_id = "admin"
}

output "admin_group_ids" {
  value = data.orchestration_cluster_role_members.example.group_ids
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `role_id` (String) The ID of the role whose members are listed. It must exist.

### Read-Only

- `client_ids` (Set of String) The IDs of the clients assigned to the role. Empty if there are none.
- `group_ids` (Set of String) The IDs of the groups assigned to the role. Empty if there are none.
- `id` (String) The ID of the role (the same as `role_id`).
- `mapping_rule_ids` (Set of String) The IDs of the mapping rules assigned to the role. Empty if there are none.
- `user_ids` (Set of String) The IDs of the users assigned to the role. Empty if there are none.
